mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id AS sellerId, u.nickname AS nickname, COUNT(p.product_id) AS productCount, AVG(r.rating) AS rating FROM users u LEFT JOIN products p ON p.seller_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN reviews r ON r.seller_id = u.user_id WHERE u.user_id = ( SELECT seller_id FROM products WHERE product_id = #{productId} ) GROUP BY u.user_id, u.nickname
SELECT image_url FROM product_images WHERE product_id = #{productId} ORDER BY sort_order ASC

SELECT t.product_id AS product_id, t.product_name AS product_name, t.price AS price, t.main_image_url AS thumbnailUrl, t.region_display_name AS regionName FROM ( SELECT p.*, CASE WHEN p.category_id = base.category_id THEN 1 WHEN c.parent_id = base.parent_id THEN 2 ELSE 99 END AS priority FROM products p JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id JOIN ( SELECT c2.category_id, c2.parent_id FROM products p2 JOIN categories c2 ON p2.category_id = c2.category_id WHERE p2.product_id = #{productId} ) base WHERE p.product_id != #{productId} ) t WHERE t.priority < 99 ORDER BY t.priority ASC, t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT p.product_id AS productId, p.product_name AS title, p.price AS price, p.main_image_url AS thumbnailUrl, p.region_display_name AS regionName, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_favorites uf WHERE uf.product_id = p.product_id ) AS likeCount FROM products p ORDER BY likeCount DESC LIMIT #{limit}
